doc: Whip pan: the outgoing clip is flung out with easeInQuart, accelerating past the canvas by 1.2 canvas widths (overshoot); the incoming clip slides in with easeOutQuart from +1.2 canvas widths and brakes into place. Each side gets a Quart opacity channel that washes out at both ends of the pan, approximating the smear of a whip pan. True motion blur needs an offscreen pass and belongs to Surface Transition (spec §9).
